item.title: Steris Corporation: VERIFY Biological/Integrator Challenge Pack Model/Catalog Number: LCB007 Recall
item.product: VERIFY Biological/Integrator Challenge Pack Model/Catalog Number: LCB007
item.summary: Geobacillus stearothermophilus spore population in affected products may fall below minimum shelf life specification. When used to monitor steam sterilization cycles, the potential hazard is that the biological indicator will show no growth, indicating that the steam cycle was effective, even if the steam cycle did not achieve the intended spore reduction Product details: VERIFY Biological/Integrator Challenge Pack Model/Catalog Number: LCB007
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
